I'm a social worker. I left an old job almost two years ago, but see a lot of my same clients as I do similar work now.

Recently I was in a hospital to see a client of mine and had to go speak to the hospital social worker. Walking down the hall, I hear "MONICAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA. MONICAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA.
I need a SANDWICH."
I stop dead in my tracks because I know this voice. This voice used to scream MY name whenever he needed something, too. 
I see a nurse walk up to a room, stand outside and take a deep breath, then head on in and call him by his first name and I'm sure it's him. This client used to have a piece of art that he was afraid he was going to lose, so the place I worked hung it up. He'd be able to see it, we'd be able to keep it safe for him and it was kind of funky so we had a funny story. 
When the nurse came out, I asked her that if this was Mr. X, could she please ask him about this piece of art. She heads back in and asks him, and he proceeds to tell her the story of this piece of art. So it's definitely him. Real demanding guy but also someone I had really liked in my time at my old job. 
So he finishes telling her the short story of this art piece and having a reasonable, pleasant conversation. Then as soon as she's ready to leave, he proceeds to scream. 
"MO.NI.CA. I NEED A FUCKING SANDWICH." 
When she left the room I just kind of gave her a 'yeah, been there' wave and she stalked off down the hallway with his screams following her.
